verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a public REST API (with OpenAPI spec) and CLI/SDK for programmatically searching GPU offers with live pricing/availability (e.g., 'vastai search offers ... -o dlperf_usd-'), and explicitly ships an agent skill so AI assistants can drive this before renting. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of live pricing accuracy via the API itself (community feedback focuses on UI pricing discoverability, not API), and no explicit rate-limit/auth-free public access details for unauthenticated querying.
